TechStartup Pvt Ltd

Privacy Policy v2.1 — August 2025

## 1 Introduction & Scope

TechStartup Pvt Ltd ('we', 'our', 'us') is committed to protecting the privacy of our users. This Privacy Policy applies to all individuals who access or use our platform, mobile applications, APIs, and related services (collectively, the 'Services').

This policy is governed by applicable Indian data protection laws and, where relevant, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for users based in the European Economic Area (EEA). We operate under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and IT (Amendment) Act, 2008.

By using our Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, you must discontinue use of our Services.

## 2 Data We Collect

### 2.1 Information You Provide Directly

- Full name and email address at account registration
- Phone number for OTP-based authentication
- Profile information including job title and company name
- Payment details processed via Razorpay (we do not store card numbers)
- Support tickets and chat transcripts when you contact us

### 2.2 Information Collected Automatically

- IP address and approximate geographic location
- Browser type, operating system, and device identifiers
- Pages visited, time spent, and clickstream data via Mixpanel
- Cookies and similar tracking technologies (see Section 8)
- Error logs and crash reports for debugging purposes

### 2.3 Information from Third Parties

- Google OAuth login data (name, email, profile picture) if you sign in with Google
- LinkedIn profile data if you use LinkedIn login

We do not purchase data from third-party data brokers or acquire data through any other means.

## 3 Legal Basis for Processing

We process personal data only when we have a valid legal basis to do so. The legal bases we rely on are:

- Contractual necessity — to provide the Services you have signed up for
- Legitimate interests — for fraud prevention, security, and product improvement
- Legal obligation — to comply with applicable laws and regulations
- Consent — for marketing communications and optional analytics (you can withdraw at any time)

Where we rely on consent, you have the right to withdraw it at any time by contacting us at privacy@techstartup.com. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing that occurred before the withdrawal.

## 4 Data Retention

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this policy.

### 4.1 Active Accounts

Data associated with active accounts is retained for the duration of the account's active status and for a period of 12 months after the account is closed, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

### 4.2 Inactive Accounts

Accounts that have shown no login activity for a period of 36 consecutive months are considered inactive. We will send a notification email 30 days before automatic deletion. Inactive accounts and all associated data are permanently deleted after the 36-month inactivity period.

### 4.3 Financial Records

Transaction records and invoices are retained for 7 years in compliance with Indian tax laws (Income Tax Act, 1961 and GST Act, 2017). These records may be anonymized after the active account period but must be retained in some form for the legally mandated period.

### 4.4 Support Data

Support tickets and communication logs are retained for 24 months from the date of the last interaction to enable quality review and dispute resolution.

## 5 User Rights

As a user of our platform, you have the following rights regarding your personal data. To exercise any of these rights, please contact privacy@techstartup.com with the subject line 'Data Rights Request'. We aim to respond to all requests within 14 business days.

### 5.1 Right to Access

You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. We will provide this in a commonly used electronic format.

### 5.2 Right to Correction

If any personal data we hold about you is inaccurate or incomplete, you may request that we correct or update it. You may also update basic profile information directly in your account settings.

### 5.3 Account Deletion

Users who wish to close their account may do so by sending an email to privacy@techstartup.com. Upon receiving a valid deletion request, we will process the request and respond within 14 days. Please note that some data may be retained as required by law (see Section 4.3).

### 5.4 Marketing Opt-Out

## 6 Data Sharing & Third Parties

We do not sell your personal data to any third parties. We share data only in the following circumstances:

|  Third Party | Purpose | Data Shared  |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  Mixpanel | Product analytics | Usage data, events, device info  |
|  Razorpay | Payment processing | Transaction amount, user ID  |
|  Google (OAuth) | Authentication | Name, email, profile picture  |
|  AWS | Cloud infrastructure & hosting | All data stored on AWS servers  |
|  Intercom | Customer support chat | Name, email, support messages  |
|  Sentry | Error monitoring | Error logs, stack traces  |

All third-party processors are bound by data processing agreements that require them to handle data in accordance with applicable privacy laws. We conduct annual reviews of our third-party processors to ensure continued compliance.

## 7 Data Security

We implement industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction, or alteration.

- All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3
- All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256
- Access to production systems is restricted to authorised personnel only via MFA
- We conduct quarterly internal security audits
- Penetration testing is conducted annually by a third-party security firm

In the event of a data breach that poses a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify affected users via email within a reasonable timeframe. We also notify relevant regulatory authorities as required by applicable law.

## 8 Cookies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve user experience and analyse platform usage. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

### Types of Cookies We Use

- Essential cookies — required for the platform to function (cannot be disabled)
- Analytics cookies — used by Mixpanel to understand how users interact with the platform
- Preference cookies — to remember your language and display settings

Privacy Policy v2.1 — August 2025

We do not use advertising or targeting cookies. You may disable non-essential cookies at any time through your browser settings without affecting core platform functionality.

## 9 International Transfers

Our primary servers are located in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) region. Some of our third-party service providers (such as Mixpanel and Sentry) may process data outside India, including in the United States and European Union.

When transferring data internationally, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where required under GDPR for EEA user data.

## 10 Children's Privacy

Our Services are not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected data from a child, please contact privacy@techstartup.com immediately and we will delete it promptly.

## 11 Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws. When we make significant changes, we will notify users via email and display a prominent notice on the platform at least 14 days before the changes take effect.

The 'Effective Date' at the top of this document indicates when the policy was last updated. Continued use of our Services after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
